paper.title_en: The Thermodynamics of Cosmological Horizons and Their Holographic Description in de Sitter Space
paper.abstract_en: We analyse the laws of thermodynamics governing the behaviour of cosmological horizons in de Sitter space and their map to a holographic description at future infinity, $\mathcal{I}^+$. In this case, the boundary can receive signals from two cosmological horizons. We find a universal form for the first law of thermodynamics, valid in general circumstances, when matter-energy crosses both horizons and impinges on the boundary. This universal form leads to a well defined notion of entropy in the holographic dual. It is specified on a co-dimension one surface of the boundary, and can be expressed as a function of two boundary charges, pressure and angular momentum, both of which are derived from the Brown-York stress tensor. Additional comments on the second law, confusing factors of $i$ which arise, and comments pertaining to JT gravity, are included towards the end.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文探讨了德西特空间中的宇宙学视界热力学及其全息描述，主题符合黑洞热力学领域。标题和摘要包含深入的理论讨论、明确的方法和结果，具有很强的相关性和理论深度，尽管推理链无法验证。
decision.title_zh: 德西特空间中宇宙学视界的热力学及其全息描述
decision.abstract_zh: 我们分析了支配德西特空间中宇宙学视界行为的热力学定律，以及它们在未来无穷远$\mathcal{I}^+$处的全息描述中的映射。在这种情况下，边界可以接收到来自两个宇宙学视界的信号。我们发现热力学第一定律的一种普遍形式，在一般情况下有效，当物质能量穿过两个视界并到达边界时。这种普遍形式导致了全息对偶中熵的一个明确定义。它被指定在边界的余维一表面上，并且可以表示为两个边界荷（压强和角动量）的函数，两者都源自Brown-York应力张量。关于第二定律的附加评论、出现的令人困惑的$i$因子，以及与JT引力相关的评论，都包含在末尾。
